from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class ExactStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_ready = False

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in symbols):
            return

        spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
        aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)

        spy_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady
        rsi_ready = self.aapl_rsi.IsReady

        spy_crossed_above = (
            spy_sma_ready
            and self.previous_spy_sma_ready
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

        spy_crossed_below = (
            spy_sma_ready
            and self.previous_spy_sma_ready
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

        if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        aapl_buy_reason = self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
        aapl_sell_reason = rsi_ready and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60

        if not self.IsWarmingUp and spy_sma_ready and rsi_ready:
            if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

            if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and aapl_sell_reason:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

            if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
                target_value = 0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
                shares = math.floor(target_value / spy_close)

                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = shares

            if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and aapl_buy_reason:
                available_cash = self.Portfolio.Cash

                if available_cash >= 20000:
                    shares = math.floor(20000 / aapl_close)

                    if shares > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                        self.strategy_b_shares = shares

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value) if spy_sma_ready else None
        self.previous_spy_sma_ready = spy_sma_ready
        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

from AlgorithmImports import *


class ExactStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = [
            self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
        ]

        self.spy = self.symbols[0]
        self.aapl = self.symbols[1]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_rsi = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if self.spy in data.Bars and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        else:
            current_spy_sma = None

        if self.aapl in data.Bars and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            current_aapl_rsi = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value
        else:
            current_aapl_rsi = None

        if self.aapl in data.Bars:
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        complete_day = all(symbol in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols)

        if (
            not self.IsWarmingUp
            and complete_day
            and current_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and current_aapl_rsi is not None
            and self.previous_aapl_rsi is not None
        ):
            spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close

            spy_crosses_below = (
                spy_close <= current_spy_sma
                and data.Bars[self.spy].Close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < self.previous_spy_sma
            )

            spy_crosses_above = (
                spy_close > current_spy_sma
                and data.Bars[self.spy].Close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            )

            # Strategy A: sell before buy.
            if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

            if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
                quantity = int(
                    (self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close
                )

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

            # Strategy B: sell before buy.
            if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and current_aapl_rsi > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

            if (
                self.strategy_b_shares == 0
                and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
                and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000
            ):
                aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        if current_spy_sma is not None:
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma

        if current_aapl_rsi is not None:
            self.previous_aapl_rsi = current_aapl_rsi
